prompt: A grey overcast city street with everyone indoors: rows of apartment windows with every blind drawn, an empty bus stop shelter at the curb, and a dome security camera on a pole in the foreground watching the street. Flat cold daylight, wet pavement, seen from across the street at a slight low angle. Semi-realistic painted graphic-novel comic art with heavy dark ink linework, diagonal hatching in the shadows and crosshatching in the deepest shadows, realistic painted shading and muted desaturated colour. An ordinary present-day American city. Every sign, screen and surface is blank and plain.
